name: Futaba☆Channel 2
source:
"Oniichan, are you running out of soap?"
My beloved niece Aoi gave me a bar of soap. She's really an adorable and thoughtful person.
Then I used it, and the strangest thing
happened...

"Oh my god I've become a young girl!"

Around the same age as little Aoi!

This could have its upside... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE056933.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
「哥哥，你的肥皂用完了吗？」
我心爱的侄女碧送给我一块肥皂。她真是可爱又体贴。
然后我用了它，匪夷所思的事
发生了……

「天哪，我变成小女孩了！」

和小碧差不多年纪！

这或许也有好的一面……

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE056933.html]DLsite English[/url]]
